correctness.rationale: The 27 explicit Fermat cubic lines form 18 threefold Eckardt crossings and 81 ordinary double crossings in characteristic zero; after blowing up triples the SNC boundary has 45 rational components and 135 nodes, yielding first Betti number 135−45+1=91 of its dual graph. Divisor classes of six E_i and F_12 integrally span Pic(S), hence H¹(U)=Q(−1)^20 and the Gysin/weight spectral sequence gives H²(U)=Q(−2)^91, no weight-2/3 pieces; affineness bounds higher cohomology and primitive meridian relations give torsion-free integral homology (1,20,91). For multiplication, the 20-kernel integral residue vectors extend to exceptional divisors by triple-point sums; the wedge double residues give a 135×190 integer matrix W, and the 135×45 boundary matrix δ has rank44. Independently reconstructing the line intersections and residue matrices from actual verify_fermat_cubic.py formulas, rank_{F101}(δ)=44 and rank_{F101}[δ|W]=135. A nonzero integer maximal minor implies rational full rank and cup surjectivity onto H²; this proves neither integral cup surjectivity nor fundamental-group claims.
